target_customer: Gamers aged 13 to 40 who want a Minecraft or Roblox style sandbox MMO
problem: Players wanted a shared persistent 3D world with stronger building tools than Minecraft and Roblox.
business_model: Game sales, free-to-play with in-game monetization, and creator tools
product_category: Sandbox MMO and UGC game platform

founders.name: Garrison Bellack
founders.background_notes: Prior employers from YC page; PC Gamer and MassivelyOP name him as co-founder and CEO per search result summaries

founders.name: Zachary Kaplan
founders.background_notes: YC page: serial entrepreneur and creative lead

exit.reason: Game retired from sale on Steam and hosted services shut down; developer disputed that it requested the takedown. Company status not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: A single shared persistent world with a small team and a broken alpha per PC Gamer was research-grade scope for the budget.

defensibility.rationale: Sandbox MMO concepts are copyable; the team had no sourced exclusive IP or user base.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were not threatened; the game itself failed on execution.

market_need_then: UGC sandbox games had huge audiences in 2021, but reporting shows the Kickstarter raised under 65K versus a stated need far larger.

identity.voice_and_tone: Hype-heavy promises of an infinite open world, criticized as overpromising

branding.community_and_virality: Loyal Discord fanbase per coverage; early Kickstarter funded within 9 hours; heavy skeptical press

brand_strength.rationale: Press notoriety (PC Gamer fiasco coverage, German gaming outlets) was largely negative; a small loyal community existed.

pivots.why: Per Gamers Unchained 2024, team planned F2P with Alpha 2; reasons beyond that not sourced

outcome_analysis: DreamWorld pitched an infinite sandbox MMO, raised under 65 thousand dollars on Kickstarter in 2021 against heavy skepticism, launched on Steam Early Access on 10 March 2026 and was pulled from sale and its servers shut down by June 2026. The record points to scope far beyond resources and weak execution; the cause of the final takedown was not made public, and no institutional round beyond YC was verified.
notes: YC lists Active and describes a next-gen Minecraft with generative AI building (30 staff), which conflicts with the MMO shutdown reporting; the YC page may describe a different framing of the same studio (developer named DreamWorld Realities Inc.). Kickstarter amount $64,706 seen in search summaries of MassivelyOP and PC Gamer; the PC Gamer shutdown article body could not be read. YC seed of about $125K is an estimate by MassivelyOP and Seedtable, not a round. Company website fetch returned no content. Name origin not found. The pivot date is from a 2024 report.
